company.name: Liberty Micro Life Insurance Limited
company.about: Liberty Micro Life is a Pokhara-based micro life insurer that began operations in November 2023. It sells low-cost life cover and small savings plans mainly to borrowers, rural families and groups, with cover limited by the micro-insurance directive.
highlights: Micro term insurance is about 72% of premium income
Also handles the Foreign Employment Insurance Fund business
Website lists 890,000+ policies issued and about 2,150 agents

policies.name: Samriddha Kavach Myadi Life Insurance (Micro Term)
policies.summary: Low-cost pure life cover for people who take loans or have no other life insurance.
features: Premium paid yearly over the policy term
Rebate of Rs 1 per thousand for sum assured of Rs 1 lakh to 1.99 lakh
Suits borrowers from banks, finance companies and self-help groups
benefits: Sum assured paid to the family if the insured dies during the term
Optional rider benefits for accidental death and disability
exclusions: Full exclusions per policy terms and conditions

policies.name: Samriddha Bhavishya Micro Life Insurance
policies.summary: A small savings plan that combines life cover with a lump sum when the term ends.
features: Savings plus protection in one micro plan
Regular premiums over a fixed term
Sum assured capped by the micro-insurance directive
benefits: Sum assured paid on death during the term
Maturity amount paid if the insured survives the term
exclusions: Suicide in the initial policy period
Full exclusions per policy terms and conditions
bestFor: Small savers wanting disciplined long-term savings

policies.name: Surakshit Bal Bhavishya Yojana
policies.summary: A child plan to save for a child's education and keep the future protected.
features: Built for children's education and future needs
Parent or guardian pays the premium
benefits: Lump sum when the plan matures
Death benefit if the policyholder dies during the term
exclusions: Suicide in the initial policy period
Full exclusions per policy terms and conditions
bestFor: Parents saving for a child's school or college costs

policies.name: Gramin Samuhik Myadi Beema Yojana (Rural Group Term)
policies.summary: Simple group life cover for rural communities, arranged through a cooperative or group.
features: Group term cover for rural members
Arranged through cooperatives or community groups
benefits: Fixed amount paid to the family on the member's death during the cover year
Cover is simple to arrange for the whole group under one policy
exclusions: Full exclusions per group policy terms

pricing.note: Indicative per-member premium for a Rs 1 lakh group term cover; actual rate set per group

bestFor: Members of rural cooperatives and village groups
